A free-boundary problem needs unknown geometry and boundary laws. Evolving Exner bed fields on a fixed horizontal domain alone do not certify a moving-shoreline problem.

For smooth material maps with positive Jacobian, rho composed with X times J equals rho0. Mass-normalized 1D coordinates divide by density and can fail at vacuum while a material-label map remains invertible. Bed-field pullbacks require the material chain-rule term.

It specializes to flat-bed shallow water. This is neither a certified Lie reduction nor a new solution/global theorem claim.
